title: When Does It Make Sense to Use iPaaS or No-Code Automation?
summary: Find out when it makes sense to use iPaaS or no-code automation, and the criteria to choose between the two.
body_markdown:
The answer to when to use iPaaS or no-code depends on what the company needs most: connecting existing systems to each other (iPaaS) or building internal processes and apps from scratch, with automation built in (no-code). The two approaches solve different problems, and many companies use both at the same time, each in the right place.


This question tends to come up when a company already has several systems (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, WhatsApp) and needs to decide whether to bring in an integration tool to connect everything, or build its own environment where processes are born already connected.


Choosing wrong is costly: an iPaaS doesn't fix the lack of a structured process, and a no-code platform alone doesn't replace very specific integrations with legacy systems.


## What an iPaaS Solves Well


- Connecting systems that already exist, without rewriting any process
- Syncing data between tools from different vendors
- Running one-off, specific integrations, with no interface of its own
- Working as a bridge between systems that lack native integration


## What a No-Code Platform Solves Well


- Building internal processes from scratch, with its own screens, forms, and flow
- Automating approvals, tasks, and steps inside a single environment
- Reducing dependence on parallel spreadsheets and loose tools
- Giving the operations team autonomy to adjust the process without IT
- Natively integrating with specific ERPs, with no need for an external connector


## Criteria to Decide Between the Two Approaches


- Is the problem a lack of connection between systems or a lack of structured process?
- Is native integration available for the most critical systems, like the ERP?
- Who will maintain the automation day to day: IT or the business team?
- What's the cost of maintaining multiple tools connected via iPaaS over time?
- Does the company also need screens and forms, or just synced data?

## Frequently asked questions


**Do iPaaS and no-code do the same thing?** No. iPaaS connects existing systems; no-code builds new processes and interfaces, like on[Jestor](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can you use iPaaS and no-code together?** Yes, many companies use iPaaS for one-off integrations and no-code for day-to-day processes.


**Which option requires less IT maintenance?** No-code platforms usually require less ongoing technical maintenance, since the business team adjusts the flow directly, which is often the deciding factor when weighing when to use iPaaS or no-code.


**Does a no-code platform replace the ERP?** No. It organizes the process and sends data to the ERP, which remains responsible for the tax and accounting side.
